items.docs: Allows authorized users to see the capacities of the service.

info.name: Returns a Tile from a Layer.

params.name: service
params.description: The format of the image you want to display

params.name: tileSet
params.description: The desired tile set from which to retrieve the tiles (currently supported set are 4326 (projected coordinates) and 3857 (spherical coordinates)). 3857 only is available at the moment.

params.name: format
params.description: the requested image format (image/jpeg or image/png).

params.name: zoomLevel
params.description: The map zoom level (Tilegrid depth). Starts at 0 and ends at 16 for SPOT layers, 17 for Pleiades layers and 19 for Pl�iades Neo layers.

params.name: tileColumn
params.description: Tilegrid column. The index of the tile column within the chosen tilegrid (different options are available with GetCapabilities). Must be inferior or equal to MatrixWidth

params.name: tileRow
params.description: Tilegrid row. The index of the tile row within the chosen tilegrid (different options are available with GetCapabilities) Must be inferior or equal to MatrixHeight.

items.docs:
Returns a 256x256 tile from a layer in JPEG or PNG format.

__IMPORTANT:__ whatever the requested image format is, a transparent image will be delivered in PNG format if no tile is found at the specified location.

__Example__: https://view-bm.api.oneatlas.airbus.com/basemap/wmts?layer=advancedBasemap&style=default&tilematrixset=3857&Service=WMTS&Request=GetTile&Version=1.0.0&Format=image/unknown&TileMatrix=18&TileCol=132063&TileRow=95710
